problem_statement: The devicetree API cannot retrieve the C symbolic name (label) of a node. Given a node identifier — including one obtained from a phandle property of another node, or a raw node label — the API should yield the node's label as a C token (e.g. STRINGIFY(DT_NODELABEL_C_TOKEN(node_id)) produces the label string), and should also be able to select a label by its index among the node's labels, so that a node with several labels (such as 'test_i2c: test_i2c1: i2c@...') can have each label's name recovered by index. A label added by a separate overlay that references the node is also retrievable by its index.

verification.reason: The task is repairable by stating the exact macro name and index semantics, plus the required binding property, without revealing the implementation.

problems.detail: The hidden test calls DT_NODELABEL_C_TOKEN_BY_IDX, but the problem statement only names DT_NODELABEL_C_TOKEN and does not give the indexed macro name or its parameters.
The exact indexing order is not specified: the test expects index 0 to be the first label, index 1 the second label, and an overlay-added label to appear after existing labels.
The hidden test's devicetree uses a new ph-conn phandle property in the vnd,phandle-holder binding, which the statement does not mention and without which the test property may not be generated.

problem_statement_fixed: The devicetree API cannot retrieve the C symbolic name (label) of a node. Given a node identifier — including one obtained from a phandle property of another node, or a raw node label — the API should yield the node's label as a C token (e.g. STRINGIFY(DT_NODELABEL_C_TOKEN(node_id)) produces the label string), and should also be able to select a label by its index among the node's labels, so that a node with several labels (such as 'test_i2c: test_i2c1: i2c@...') can have each label's name recovered by index. A label added by a separate overlay that references the node is also retrievable by its index. The macro for indexed retrieval shall be named DT_NODELABEL_C_TOKEN_BY_IDX(node_id, idx). DT_NODELABEL_C_TOKEN(node_id) returns the first label, i.e. the label at index 0, and DT_NODELABEL_C_TOKEN_BY_IDX(node_id, idx) returns the idx-th label in left-to-right order; a label added by an overlay referencing the node appears after labels already present on the node. The vnd,phandle-holder binding must include a ph-conn property of type phandle.
